dataset.name: Australian PDAC non-overlapping extension (QCMG/UQ, 2016)
dataset.description: Eighteen primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas from the Bailey QCMG/UQ release that do not occur in the active ICGC Release 28 PACA-AU expression cohort, with bulk RNA-seq and exact overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The Bailey release contains 96 pancreatic tumors. TRACE Explorer retains only 18 primary tumors explicitly annotated as pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma that are absent from the active 66-patient PACA-AU release. The other 52 expression- and endpoint-complete PDAC identifiers overlap the active release, and 26 non-PDAC histologies are excluded.

metadata.source_program: Australian Pancreatic Cancer Genome Initiative / QCMG
metadata.overlap_note: The 18 retained ICGC submitted donor identifiers have zero overlap with the 66 patients in the active PACA-AU release. Because both releases derive from the same Australian study program and use different expression quantifications, they remain separate and must not be treated as independent studies in a meta-analysis.
metadata.histology_note: Only exact Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma records are eligible. Invasive IPMN, adenosquamous, acinar, undifferentiated, mucinous non-cystic, clear-cell and signet-ring records are excluded.
metadata.curation_note: The explicit patient allow-list is the set difference between the 70 exact-PDAC expression/OS records in the pinned QCMG/UQ matrix and the 66 submitted donor identifiers represented by the active ICGC Release 28 PACA-AU cohort. The intersection contains 52 identifiers, leaving 18 QCMG/UQ-only patients.

expression.label: Provided log2 TMM-normalized CPM
expression.source_unit: RSEM; TMM-normalized log2 counts per million
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided HUGO symbol and Entrez gene identifier pair
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with an identical source-provided HUGO/Entrez pair are averaged sample-wise; symbols attached to conflicting source identifiers are excluded.
expression.scale_note: Bailey et al. report RSEM quantification followed by edgeR TMM normalization, conversion to counts per million and log2 transformation. The pinned DataHub values are preserved without a second transformation.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause, including source labels DOD, DOC and deceased with unknown cause
